title: Strict logification extends compatible differential symbols
statement:
Let c:(Z,L)->(W,M), g:(W,M)->(S,N) be composable maps of fine etale log structures on arbitrary schemes [def-pc-scheme], and assume c is strict in the canonical stalk-pushout sense of [def-sfb-log-infinitesimal-lifting-properties]. Use composition [def-per-log-map-composition] and the actual differential symbol sheaves [def-per-log-differential-symbol-sheaf]. Fix any ordinary presentations ΩW for g and ΩZ for gc and pullback presentations A=c*ΩW, C=c*ω_g as in [def-per-etale-differential-pullback-presentation]. Let u:A->ΩZ and v:A->C have the normalized formulas u(1 tensor da)=d(c-sharp a), v(1 tensor da)=1 tensor d_g a on every relative etale diagram. For every O_Z-module sheaf T and maps p:ΩZ->T and q:C->T satisfying u followed by p = v followed by q, there is a map ψ:ω_gc->T such that on all etale objects and relative diagrams
ψ(d_gc a)=p(da),
ψ(dlog_gc(c-flat m))=q(1 tensor dlog_g m),
and for every unit function t and every l in L with alpha_L(l)=t,
ψ(dlog_gc l)=p(t^-1 dt).
The first two formulas alone determine ψ uniquely. No comparison isomorphism, pushout property, or inverse composite is asserted here. No smoothness, flatness, saturation or Noetherian assumption is made.

proof.text: Use the small skeletons in [def-weil-size-convention]. Put $H=c^{-1}M$, $\beta=c^\sharp\alpha:H\to\mathcal O_Z$, and $E(U)=\{h\in H(U):\beta(h)\in\mathcal O_Z(U)^\times\}$. Define a presheaf $Q(U)$ as the quotient of $H(U)\times\mathcal O_Z(U)^\times$ by the monoid congruence generated by $(he,t)\sim(h,\beta(e)t)$ for $e\in E(U)$. Restrictions preserve these relations. By [lem-trf-commutative-monoid-sheafification] it has a monoid sheafification $Q^\#$ whose underlying set sheaf is the set sheafification. The natural maps $h\mapsto[h,1]$, $t\mapsto[1,t]$ and $[h,t]\mapsto\beta(h)t$ extend to sheaves by its universal property.

source.place: Original pushout Step 1; ILO VI 1.1 convention, Stacks 00YR.

proof.text: The local-representatives assertion of [lem-weil-pbc-site-sheafification-sections-local] proves the log axiom for $Q^\#$: if $[h,t]$ has unit image, then $h\in E$ locally and $[h,t]=[1,\beta(h)t]$. Thus every section with unit image is the canonical section of that unit; the structural map is a left inverse on units, so these are unique. For any log structure $K$ and structurally compatible $f:H\to K$, the formula $[h,t]\mapsto f(h)j_K(t)$ respects the congruence, since $f(e)=j_K(\beta(e))$ for $e\in E$ by the log axiom of $K$. It extends uniquely through monoid sheafification and is the only extension because the values on units are forced. Hence $Q^\#$ has the defining universal property of the associated log structure of $H\to\mathcal O_Z$. Strictness identifies it canonically with $L$. In particular every section of $L$ is locally $c^\flat(h)t$, with exactly the congruence and the subsequent sheafification equalities just described. In the Lean predicate, strictness is given on geometric stalks with the canonical germ maps. The construction has these same stalk pushouts, so their canonical sheaf map is an isomorphism, since geometric stalks detect isomorphisms.

proof.text: In the arbitrary target T define D(a)=p(da) and ell(h)=q(1 tensor dlog_g h). The two normalizations and u followed by p = v followed by q give D(beta(h))=beta(h)ell(h). D is an additive relative derivation; ell is additive under multiplication and annihilates base log symbols.

source.place: Original pushout Step 4, replacing the quotient target by any compatible target.

proof.text:
For a unit $t$, put $\lambda(t)=t^{-1}D(t)$. Leibniz gives $\lambda(tt')=\lambda(t)+\lambda(t')$ and $D(1)=0$. For $e\in E$, the preceding identity gives $\ell(e)=\beta(e)^{-1}D(\beta(e))=\lambda(\beta(e))$. Consequently the monoid homomorphism to the additive monoid of $T$ given by
$$H(U)\times\mathcal O_Z(U)^\times\longrightarrow T(U),\qquad(h,t)\longmapsto\ell(h)+\lambda(t)$$
sends $(he,t)$ and $(h,\beta(e)t)$ to the same element. It therefore factors through the generated congruence, not merely through a choice of local representatives, and defines a natural map $Q\to(T,+)$. This works in any compatible target T.

Regard the underlying additive sheaf of $T$ as a commutative-monoid sheaf, using [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. The universal property in [lem-trf-commutative-monoid-sheafification] extends the congruence-compatible map uniquely to a monoid map $\ell_L:L=Q^\#\to(T,+)$. Its formula on local representatives is
$$\ell_L(c^\flat(h)t)=\ell(h)+t^{-1}D(t).$$
The underlying-set clause and [lem-weil-pbc-site-sheafification-sections-local] ensure that this is independent also of equalities arising only after sheafification: representatives of the same section agree after a covering, their images then agree, and the sheaf $T$ glues them uniquely. All formulas commute with restrictions since $D$, $\ell$, multiplication and inversion of units do.

For l=c-flat(h)t compute D(alpha(l))=D(beta(h)t)=t beta(h)ell(h)+beta(h)D(t)=alpha(l)ell_L(l). The sheaf axiom makes the identity global. The log map is additive and kills N, and the ordinary map kills the S-functions, so all six defining relations vanish. Factor the free-symbol map through the cokernel and its module sheafification to obtain ψ. Its values on da, pulled-back dlog and unit dlog are the stated three formulas.

For any other map satisfying the first two formulas, the structural relation d(t)=t dlog(l) with alpha(l)=t invertible forces the unit formula. On each local representative l=c-flat(h)t, logarithmic additivity then fixes the value on dlog(l). Thus both maps agree on all ordinary and log symbols, hence on the free module, its quotient and its sheafification. This proves uniqueness from the first two formulas alone.

No associated-log or log-symbol extension result. Inspected the ordinary Derivation.postcomp and free module/sheafification adjunction APIs.

No Mathlib hits. Project PrelogPushoutHomExtension and EtaleLogPresentationComparison only extend to log structures with structural maps, require locally Noetherian schemes, and do not extend symbols into an arbitrary module sheaf. AssociatedLogArbitraryScheme concerns saturation and integrality, and LogSmoothDifferentialGenerators assumes log smoothness and concerns a stalk basis. None states this extension theorem.

lean.statement:
theorem strictLog_symbol_extension {Z W S : Scheme.{u}}
    {L : EtaleLogStructure Z} {M : EtaleLogStructure W} {N : EtaleLogStructure S}
    (c : EtaleLogMap L M) (g : EtaleLogMap M N)
    (hL : L.IsFine) (hM : M.IsFine) (hN : N.IsFine) (hc : c.IsStrict)
    (ΩW : EtaleOrdinaryDifferentialPresentation g.base)
    (ΩZ : EtaleOrdinaryDifferentialPresentation (c.base ≫ g.base))
    (A : EtaleDifferentialPullbackPresentation c.base ΩW.module)
    (C : EtaleDifferentialPullbackPresentation c.base g.differentialSheaf)
    (u : A.module ⟶ ΩZ.module) (v : A.module ⟶ C.module)
    (hu : ∀ (U : W.Etale) (V : Z.Etale) (k : V.left ⟶ U.left)
      (hk : k ≫ U.hom = V.hom ≫ c.base) (a : Γ(U.left, ⊤)),
      u.val.app (op V) (A.unit.app U V k hk (ΩW.derivation.d (X := op U) a)) =
        ΩZ.derivation.d (X := op V) (k.appTop a))
    (hv : ∀ (U : W.Etale) (V : Z.Etale) (k : V.left ⟶ U.left)
      (hk : k ≫ U.hom = V.hom ≫ c.base) (a : Γ(U.left, ⊤)),
      v.val.app (op V) (A.unit.app U V k hk (ΩW.derivation.d (X := op U) a)) =
        C.unit.app U V k hk (g.sheafD U a))
    (T : DifferentialEtaleModules Z) (p : ΩZ.module ⟶ T) (q : C.module ⟶ T)
    (hpq : u ≫ p = v ≫ q) :
    ∃ ψ : (c.comp g).differentialSheaf ⟶ T,
      (∀ (V : Z.Etale) (a : Γ(V.left, ⊤)),
        ψ.val.app (op V) ((c.comp g).sheafD V a) =
          p.val.app (op V) (ΩZ.derivation.d (X := op V) a)) ∧
      (∀ (U : W.Etale) (V : Z.Etale) (k : V.left ⟶ U.left)
        (hk : k ≫ U.hom = V.hom ≫ c.base) (m : M.monoidSheaf.obj.obj (op U)),
        ψ.val.app (op V) ((c.comp g).sheafDLog V (c.sectionMap U V k hk m)) =
          q.val.app (op V) (C.unit.app U V k hk (g.sheafDLog U m))) ∧
      (∀ (V : Z.Etale) (t : Γ(V.left, ⊤)ˣ)
        (l : L.monoidSheaf.obj.obj (op V)), L.alpha.app (op V) l = t.val →
        ψ.val.app (op V) ((c.comp g).sheafDLog V l) =
          p.val.app (op V)
            ((↑(t⁻¹) : Γ(V.left, ⊤)) • ΩZ.derivation.d (X := op V) t.val)) ∧
      (∀ ψ' : (c.comp g).differentialSheaf ⟶ T,
        (∀ (V : Z.Etale) (a : Γ(V.left, ⊤)),
          ψ'.val.app (op V) ((c.comp g).sheafD V a) =
            p.val.app (op V) (ΩZ.derivation.d (X := op V) a)) →
        (∀ (U : W.Etale) (V : Z.Etale) (k : V.left ⟶ U.left)
          (hk : k ≫ U.hom = V.hom ≫ c.base) (m : M.monoidSheaf.obj.obj (op U)),
          ψ'.val.app (op V) ((c.comp g).sheafDLog V (c.sectionMap U V k hk m)) =
            q.val.app (op V) (C.unit.app U V k hk (g.sheafDLog U m))) → ψ' = ψ)
